resource_group_name.title: Resource Group Name
resource_group_name.description: The name of the resource group in which to create the proximity placement group.

allowed_vm_sizes.title: Allowed Vm Sizes
allowed_vm_sizes.description: (Optional) Specifies the supported sizes of virtual machines that can be created in the proximity placement group.

enable_telemetry.title: Enable Telemetry
enable_telemetry.description: This variable controls whether or not telemetry is enabled for the module. For more information see https://aka.ms/avm/telemetryinfo. If it is set to false, then no telemetry will be collected.

lock.title: Lock
lock.description: Controls the Resource Lock configuration for this resource. The following properties can be specified:  - `kind` - (Required) The type of lock. Possible values are `\"CanNotDelete\"` and `\"ReadOnly\"`. - `name` - (Optional) The name of the lock. If not specified, a name will be generated based on the `kind` value. Changing this forces the creation of a new resource.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Map of tags to assign to the proximity placement group.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: (Required) Specifies the supported zone of the proximity placement group. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

location.title: Location
location.description: The Azure location where the proximity placement group should exist.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the proximity placement group.
